Calibration remains enabled after C deletion; these are conditional trade-offs, not an isolated intervention on every aggregation operation.

changes.label: R3.7 all-scene trade-offs, preselected subset reversals and seed-first scope
changes.old: The two completed C scenes provide another bounded counterexample to a universal component-benefit claim. For IID F Flip, the native/shared paired ACC/AEOD/ASPD differences are +0.518±0.814 / +0.00139±0.01487 / +0.01098±0.02176, whereas raw gives +0.530±0.875 / +0.00465±0.01053 / +0.00703±0.01157 (ACC in percentage points; all values are means ± sample SD). Thus deletion improves accuracy but worsens both disparity means in the ten-seed panel. The native/shared F Flip AEOD difference is +0.00025±0.01530 in the nine-seed panel and -0.00291±0.01773 in the six-seed panel, showing that even its mean direction depends on the predefined subset. These descriptive results neither establish significance nor identify necessity or a causal mechanism. They do not extrapolate to the other eight C scenes or the other incomplete image controls.
changes.new:
The five completed IID C scenes provide another bounded counterexample to a universal component-benefit claim. For IID F Flip, the native/shared paired ACC/AEOD/ASPD differences are +0.518±0.814 / +0.00139±0.01487 / +0.01098±0.02176, whereas raw gives +0.530±0.875 / +0.00465±0.01053 / +0.00703±0.01157 (ACC in percentage points; all values are means ± sample SD). Thus deletion improves accuracy but worsens both disparity means in the ten-seed panel. The native/shared F Flip AEOD difference is +0.00025±0.01530 in the nine-seed panel and -0.00291±0.01773 in the six-seed panel, showing that even its mean direction depends on the predefined subset. These descriptive results neither establish significance nor identify necessity or a causal mechanism. They do not extrapolate to the five non-IID C scenes or the other incomplete image controls.

The added scenes also retain counterexamples and subset dependence. In the ten-seed native/shared panel, deleting C under IID FedSA raises ACC and ASPD while lowering AEOD; under IID S-DFA it lowers ACC and raises both gaps. For FedSA, native/shared AEOD changes from a lower ten-seed mean to a higher mean in both sensitivity panels, while ASPD changes from a higher mean to lower means. In the raw nine-seed FedSA panel, deletion improves all three means, whereas in the raw six-seed panel it raises both gaps. S-DFA native/shared ACC reverses from a lower ten-/nine-seed mean to a higher six-seed mean. For Sp-DFA, the native/shared paired ACC difference is +0.134 ± 0.786 percentage points for nine seeds and -0.066 ± 0.881 for six seeds; lower AEOD and higher ASPD remain in both subsets. Raw Sp-DFA retains ACC-up/AEOD-up/ASPD-up in both subsets. The fixed panels are reported together, without selecting the favorable panel.

The [five-scene table](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_five_scenes_20261010/snapshot/TABLES.md) reports every Full/C mean and paired difference for raw, native and shared-calibration views and identical 10/9/6-seed panels. The separate [cross-scene summary](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_five_scenes_20261010/snapshot/cross_scene_seed_first.json) first averages the five IID scenes within each seed, then calculates across-seed mean and sample SD; its sample size is the seed count. Its ten-seed native/shared mean trades lower AEOD for higher ASPD after C deletion, while raw raises both disparity means. These descriptions preserve the earlier Benign, F Flip and COMPAS counterexamples and do not establish uniform component benefit, necessity, significance or a pure aggregation causal effect.

changes.new:
**Image C-deletion evidence, five IID scenes only.** We separately compare 50 minus_C models with 50 existing Full checkpoints for IID Benign, F Flip, FedSA, S-DFA and Sp-DFA, ten matched seeds per scene. The C mask removes the scoring contribution while leaving geometric hard filtering enabled; it does not delete prediction calibration. Each model supplies all metrics and raw/native/shared views from the same round-70 checkpoint. Paired native/shared ACC/AEOD/ASPD differences (minus_C−Full) are -0.083±1.378 / +0.00292±0.01315 / -0.00142±0.01953 for IID Benign and +0.518±0.814 / +0.00139±0.01487 / +0.01098±0.02176 for IID F Flip, with ACC in percentage points. Thus the F Flip ten-seed deletion improves accuracy but raises both measured disparities; these are paired means ± sample SD, not significance or necessity claims. The native/shared F Flip AEOD difference changes from the ten-seed positive mean to +0.00025±0.01530 for nine seeds and -0.00291±0.01773 for six seeds. [The accepted five-scene table](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_five_scenes_20261010/snapshot/TABLES.md) retains every Full/C mean, paired difference and the fixed 10/9/6-seed raw/native/shared panels. The five non-IID C scenes and six other image controls remain incomplete, leaving seven image-control variants incomplete. These five IID scenes do not support a claim that every term is necessary or a causal explanation of dataset-dependent behavior.

**Additional C-scene trade-offs.** For Sp-DFA, ten-seed paired native/shared ACC/AEOD/ASPD differences are +0.042 ± 0.796 / -0.00668 ± 0.00848 / +0.00810 ± 0.02432, versus +0.097 ± 0.909 / +0.00523 ± 0.01289 / +0.00392 ± 0.01422 in raw, with ACC in percentage points and all values mean ± sample SD (ddof=1). The native/shared ACC difference reverses from +0.134 ± 0.786 for nine seeds to -0.066 ± 0.881 for six seeds, while lower AEOD and higher ASPD persist. For FedSA, deleting C raises native/shared ten-seed ACC and ASPD while lowering AEOD; both gap directions reverse in the fixed nine-/six-seed subsets. Raw nine-seed FedSA improves all three means after deletion, whereas raw six-seed FedSA raises both gaps. S-DFA native/shared deletion lowers ACC and raises both gaps in the ten-seed panel; its ACC direction reverses in the six-seed subset. All unfavorable outcomes and subset reversals remain in the full table, without choosing a favorable view or panel.

**Cross-scene interpretation.** The [seed-first summary](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_five_scenes_20261010/snapshot/cross_scene_seed_first.json) averages the five IID scenes within each seed before computing across-seed mean and sample SD.
